# All prefix questions can still omit an intermediate loss

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`prefix-observation-loss` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F22 · [record](prefix-observation-loss.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Two configurations reached from one origin pass the same tests of completed blocks and of every nonempty prefix, yet only one can lose its continuation midway; no prefix test reads the loss, and exposing the suffix where the course stands recovers it.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Midway is a frame of six configurations and three moves, with no claims: enter takes origin to risky or safe, begin takes risky to ready or blocked and safe to ready, and finish takes ready to done; risky and safe are both reached from origin by enter. (`Becoming.Midway.Step`, `Becoming.Midway.frame`, `Becoming.Midway.shared_origin`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
2. Read in blocks of the completed course, begin then finish, and in blocks of its nonempty prefixes, begin and begin then finish, risky and safe are alike, and so pass the same branching tests of those blocks. (`Becoming.Midway.completed`, `Becoming.Midway.prefixes`, `Becoming.Midway.same_completed_tests`, `Becoming.Midway.same_prefix_tests`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
3. From risky, begin can lead to where finish cannot be taken, and from safe it cannot; every description whose equal codes pass the same branching tests of the frame gives risky and safe different codes. (`Becoming.Midway.lost`, `Becoming.Midway.internal_loss`, `Becoming.Midway.codes_apart`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
4. No branching test of the prefix blocks holds exactly where begin can lead to where finish cannot be taken; tests richer than those of the prefix blocks are not excluded. (`Becoming.Midway.no_prefix_reading`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
5. Read in blocks of the suffixes exposed where the course stands, finish and begin, the test that begin can lead to where finish cannot be taken holds at risky and fails at safe. (`Becoming.Midway.resumable`, `Becoming.Midway.resumption_recovers_loss`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
6. A description giving one code to configurations that pass the same tests of the prefix blocks has no reading of its codes that answers every branching test of the frame exactly. (`Becoming.Midway.reduced_prefix_cannot_extend`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- One explicit relation of six configurations and three moves; the prefix blocks are begin and begin then finish, with no claims (an empty atomic vocabulary).
- The non-reading theorem needs no reduction; the impossibility of extending a description already merging what the prefix tests merge takes that reduction as a hypothesis.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- The witness refutes the sufficiency of this prefix language only, not of every coarse description or generative grounding. Witness: `Becoming.Midway.no_prefix_reading`.
- The non-reading does not extend to richer atomic tests or to codes not reduced to the prefix tests, which may keep the distinction.
- Reality is not shown to require these names of moves.
- The witness is restated on the core frame; its correspondence with the earlier periphery model is not shown.
- **Counterexample:** Midway.same_prefix_tests and Midway.internal_loss: risky and safe pass the same tests of the prefix blocks, yet only from risky can begin lead to where finish cannot be taken, so the prefix tests do not read a loss midway (Midway.no_prefix_reading). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Granularity.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.
